name: What Should You Ask a Driveway Contractor Before Hiring?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a driveway contractor before hiring them?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a driveway contractor before hiring them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring, homeowners should ask questions that reveal both competence and transparency. Good questions include: How many similar driveways have you completed in Los Angeles County? Who will actually do the work? Do you handle permits and inspections? How will you address drainage, slope, and base preparation? What is included in the bid, and what would count as extra work? What warranty do you provide? How long before the driveway can be walked on and driven on? Can you provide local references or photos of finished work? These questions matter because driveway jobs often fail due to weak base prep, poor drainage planning, or vague pricing rather than the visible top layer alone. A reliable contractor should answer directly and in writing. If the answers are evasive or inconsistent, the homeowner may face change orders, schedule delays, or durability problems later. The goal is not just to find the lowest price, but to understand exactly what is being built and how it will hold up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about license and insurance, similar local projects, permit handling, drainage solutions, timeline, payment schedule, warranty, and what is excluded from the bid. You should also ask who performs the work, whether subcontractors are used, and how cleanup and access will be managed. Clear answers usually indicate a more organized contractor.
